+import io
+from azure.ai.documentintelligence import DocumentIntelligenceClient
+from azure.core.credentials import AzureKeyCredential

+def extract_receipt_fields(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    with DocumentIntelligenceClient(config['endpoint'], AzureKeyCredential(config['api_key'])) as client:
+        result = client.begin_analyze_document('prebuilt-receipt', body=io.BytesIO(payload['document_bytes']), content_type=payload['mime_type']).result()
+    receipts = []
+    for document in result.documents or []:
+        fields = document.fields or {}
+        text = lambda values, key: values[key].content if key in values else None
+        items = fields.get('Items')
+        line_items = []
+        for item in (items.value_array or []) if items else []:
+            values = item.value_object or {}
+            line_items.append({'description': text(values, 'Description'), 'quantity': text(values, 'Quantity'), 'amount': text(values, 'Amount')})
+        receipts.append({'merchant': text(fields, 'MerchantName'), 'tax': text(fields, 'TotalTax'), 'total': text(fields, 'Total'), 'items': line_items})
+    return {'receipts': receipts}

+def validate_document_fields(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
